message.content:
The user wants a 7-day learning roadmap for building a full-stack web app with React (frontend) and Go (backend). They also want bilingual content with key terms in both English and 中文 (Chinese). I need to structure this as a clear, actionable plan with daily content and exercises. Let me organize this: **Day 1: Environment Setup & Basics** - React fundamentals - Go basics - Development environment **Day 2: React Core Concepts** - Components, JSX, Props, State - Exercise: Build a simple component **Day 3: React Advanced & State Management** - Hooks, Context API - Exercise: Build a counter or todo app **Day 4: Go Backend Fundamentals** - HTTP server, routing - Exercise: Build a simple API **Day 5: Database & API Integration** - PostgreSQL/MySQL with Go - REST API design - Exercise: Connect frontend to backend **Day 6: Full-Stack Integration** - Connecting React to Go API - CRUD operations - Exercise: Build a mini project **Day 7: Deployment & Polish** - Testing, deployment - Best practices - Exercise: Complete mini project I'll make sure to include key terms in both English and Chinese throughout the roadmap. # Full-Stack Web Development Roadmap ## React (Frontend) + Go (Backend) | 7天学习计划 --- ## 📅 Day 1: Environment Setup & Foundations ### 环境搭建与基础 **Content:** | Topic | English | 中文 | |-------|---------|------| | Development Environment | IDE/Editor Setup (VS Code) | 集成开发环境配置 | | Node.js & npm | Node.js & npm Installation | Node.js 和 npm 安装 | | Go Installation | Go SDK Setup | Go SDK 安装 | | Version Control | Git Basics | Git 基础 | **Learning Objectives:** - Install and configure VS Code / GoLand - Set up Node.js (v18+) and Go (v1.21+) - Create project directories - Initialize Git repository **Exercise 练习:** ```bash # Terminal commands mkdir fullstack-project cd fullstack-project git init ``` --- ## 📅 Day 2: React Fundamentals ### React 基础 **Content:** | Term | English | 中文 | |------|---------|------| | JSX | JavaScript XML | JSX 语法 | | Component | Functional Component | 函数组件 | | Props | Properties | 属性传递 | | State | Component State | 组件状态 | **Learning Objectives:** - Understand JSX syntax - Create functional components - Pass and use props - Use useState hook **Exercise 练习:** ```jsx // Create a simple greeting component function Greeting({ name }) { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); return (

Hello, {name}!

Count: {count}

); } ``` **Mini Project 小项目:** Counter App (计数器) --- ## 📅 Day 3: React Advanced Concepts ### React 高级概念 **Content:** | Term | English | 中文 | |------|---------|------| | Hooks | React Hooks | React 钩子 | | Effect | useEffect | 副作用钩子 | | Context | Context API | 上下文 API | | Conditional Rendering | Conditional Rendering | 条件渲染 | | List Rendering | List & Keys | 列表渲染与 Keys | **Learning Objectives:** - Master useEffect for side effects -
